title: Shader DJ Studio: Audio-Reactive Coffee Break
description: A coffee mug and boombox sit on a neon-lit desk. The user controls custom shader effects on both objects through an interactive panel: adjusting fresnel glow intensity, holographic dissolve thresholds, chromatic aberration, animated noise displacement, and a shared beat-pulse parameter that makes both objects throb in sync. Each parameter change triggers visible shader updates with validation feedback.
prompt:
Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 that loads coffeeMug.glb and BoomBox.glb via GLTFLoader from a shared_assets folder. Place the boombox on the left and the coffee mug on the right on a flat plane representing a desk, with the camera positioned at a slight overhead angle looking down at both objects. Use OrbitControls for camera interaction.

Implement custom ShaderMaterial replacements applied to both loaded models using onBeforeCompile or by traversing meshes and replacing materials. The shaders must include these uniform-driven effects: (1) a fresnel rim glow with adjustable color and intensity, (2) a holographic dissolve effect using a noise-based threshold that reveals or hides geometry, (3) chromatic aberration on a post-processing pass using EffectComposer and custom ShaderPass, (4) vertex displacement driven by simplex noise with adjustable amplitude, and (5) a shared beat-pulse uniform that scales both objects sinusoidally.

Create an HTML/CSS overlay panel with 6 sliders and 1 color picker: Fresnel Intensity (0.0-3.0, default 1.0), Dissolve Threshold (0.0-1.0, default 0.0), Chromatic Aberration Strength (0.0-0.05, default 0.0), Noise Displacement Amplitude (0.0-0.3, default 0.0), Beat Pulse Speed (0.0-5.0, default 1.0), Beat Pulse Strength (0.0-0.5, default 0.1), and Glow Color (default #00ffff). Each slider must validate its range and clamp values. Display the current numeric value next to each slider.

Add a Reset All button that animates all parameters back to defaults over 0.5 seconds using lerp. Add a Randomize button that sets all parameters to random valid values. Both buttons should update slider positions to match. Use three-point lighting with a key light, fill light, and rim light. The desk plane should have a subtle reflective material. Animate uniforms in the render loop. All shader uniforms must update in real-time as sliders change.
